technology: Python bounded JSON admission and whole-tuple indexing
constraints: Two immutable UTF-8 messages, each at most 65536 bytes and depth eight
At most sixteen domain profiles and sixteen campaign cases
Exact sensor-set equality, explicit nulls, bidirectional coverage
No target ABI, hard deadline, independent policy distribution or persistent store requirement

alternatives.assessment: Closed structs and constraints suit profile shape, but raw token admission and both report relations still need a host boundary.
Typed configuration and semantic hashes are useful for authoring. This boundary accepts no expressions or imports and commits raw bytes, not normalized expressions.
Set relations are a credible fit. An independent policy engine does not remove strict raw-token admission, and no independently deployed rules are required here.
Native streaming or typed admission remains credible if a target ABI or measured resource deficit becomes decisive. Neither is currently required.

rationale: Python pair and numeric-token hooks preserve strict admission before normalization. Immutable bytes retain exact commitments. Whole tuple indexing implements both coverage directions without Cartesian products or null wildcards. Select on these concrete mechanisms, not incumbency; no comparative performance claim.
reopen_when: A target native ABI is required
